steps.subject: Welcome to ServicePros. Let's get your business ready.
steps.heading: Welcome to ServicePros
steps.body: Your provider account is ready. Start with the basics so customers can understand what you offer and where you work.

steps.subject: Verify your contact details so customers can trust your profile
steps.heading: Confirm your contact details
steps.body: Contact verification is free and takes a few minutes. It also unlocks Pro and sponsored placement purchase eligibility.
bullets: Use Billing and Pro when you are ready

steps.subject: Small profile updates that make your business easier to choose
steps.heading: Make your profile easier to compare
steps.body: Customers scan profiles quickly. Clear copy, real images, and specific services help them decide whether you are the right fit.

steps.subject: Show customers exactly what they can book
steps.heading: Add services customers can understand
steps.body: Service listings work best when each offer has a clear title, price, description, and image.

steps.subject: Keep your profile active with posts and stories
steps.heading: Share recent work from your dashboard
steps.body: Posts and stories give customers fresh context when they visit your profile.

steps.subject: Your provider wallet: how credits work
steps.heading: Understand your provider wallet
steps.body: Billing keeps your wallet, Pro membership, plan, and transaction history in one place.

steps.subject: What ServicePros Pro unlocks, and what it does not
steps.heading: Learn what Pro is for
steps.body: Pro unlocks provider tools. It is not a verification badge, and it does not change organic ranking.

steps.subject: How sponsored placements work on ServicePros
steps.heading: Reserve labelled placement time
steps.body: Sponsored placements are flat-rate, time-boxed slots. They are labelled clearly and never reorder organic results.

steps.subject: Welcome to ServicePros. Find the right provider faster.
steps.heading: Welcome to ServicePros
steps.body: Your account is ready. You can search by category, city, provider name, or service.

steps.subject: What provider verification means on ServicePros
steps.heading: Know what each badge means
steps.body: Verification badges explain what has been checked, from basic contact confirmation to business or identity checks.
bullets: CIPC and FICA checks when available

steps.subject: How ServicePros credits help you book services
steps.heading: Understand your credits
steps.body: Credits are your customer wallet balance. You top up once, then use credits when booking services.

steps.subject: A simple way to compare service providers
steps.heading: Compare before you choose
steps.body: Provider profiles bring together services, prices, reviews, location, and verification signals.

steps.subject: Ready to contact a provider?
steps.heading: Find a provider for the job
steps.body: When you are ready, open a provider profile and choose the service that fits what you need.

steps.subject: Before you book: what to check on a provider profile
steps.heading: Book with clearer context
steps.body: A good profile should help you understand the provider before you commit.

steps.subject: Popular services near you
steps.heading: Explore local providers
steps.body: Browse providers by city and category when you want a quicker starting point.

steps.subject: Still looking for help with a service?
steps.heading: Pick up where you left off
steps.body: Your account is ready whenever you need a local provider.
